caption:
Long Thanksgiving drive on Thursday? Print a few of these before you leave. 🚗

My ADHD Fun Learning Workbook has 37 activity pages: mazes, spot the difference, find and circle, tracing and more, plus picture sudoku, connect the dots, odd one out, memory and pattern games. Here are three of them.

They're screen-free, hands-on activities for quiet time, made for parents, teachers and homeschool families. The pages are 6 x 9 in, and you get a print-ready PDF plus PNG and JPG files.

It's an instant download, so you can print as many as you need at home tonight.
